name: 7193-sharedprefix-llama31-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 2000 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, warmup the first 30% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn: one shared prefix of 512 tokens (prefix_buckets, prefix_count 1) plus 1024 unique prompt tokens in, 512 tokens out, temperature 0.0.
purpose: An 8B-parameter document assistant answering 64 concurrent single-turn queries sharing a common instruction preamble on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM v0.5.4-era engine args (commit 8d59dbb00044): `enable-prefix-caching` and
# `use-v2-block-manager` both default to False here, so both have to be written out.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: true
use-v2-block-manager: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
# max-model-len is pinned, not defaulted: this checkpoint declares 131072, and with chunked
# prefill off the per-step prefill budget is derived from it.
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
